How do I use AI Agent Studio?

G59779-01

26D

sources.title: 🐴 Choose How to Create Workflows and Agentic Applications
sources.quote: You can create workflows in either of these ways:

sources.title: 🐴 Create Workflows
sources.quote: Specify where to send an email when a workflow instance runs into a permanent error.

sources.title: 🐴 Nodes in Workflows
sources.quote: Here are some of the nodes that are available for workflows:

sources.title: 🐴 Variables Specific to Workflows
sources.quote: Node inputs are variables used to pass input to the node in the workflow.

sources.title: 🐴 Expressions
sources.quote: You can directly enter expressions in the required format,

sources.title: 🐴 Configure Workflow Triggers
sources.quote: Triggers activate after the workflow is published.

sources.title: 🐴 Add External REST Tool
sources.quote: Select Require Human Approval to ensure that a person reviews and approves any action before the tool runs.

sources.title: 🐴 Add MCP Tool
sources.quote: Add a new tool of type MCP.

sources.title: 🐴 Configure Tool Nodes in a Workflow
sources.quote: Function: Select the function to use from the connector.

sources.title: 🐴 Add an Approval Process Channel to a Human Approval Node of Workflows
sources.quote: The workflow resumes after the required approval outcome is received.

sources.title: 🐴 Add a Reference Block to a Reference Node of Workflows
sources.quote: Reference blocks define reusable logic in agentic workflows.

sources.title: 🐴 Edit a Workflow
sources.quote: You can edit workflows that are in draft status.

sources.title: 🐴 Overview of the Debugger
sources.quote: Duration: How long the node took to run.

sources.title: 🐴 Create and Use Run Profiles
sources.quote: Use run profiles to save and replay common test inputs without retyping prompts,

sources.title: 🐴 Inspect Node Results
sources.quote: For Loop and While Loop nodes, inspect the collection or condition,

sources.title: 🐴 Build Agentic Applications Using App Builder
sources.quote: Only the workflows that are enabled for using in agentic apps are available for selection.

sources.title: 🐴 Create and Enable Workflows for Using in Agentic Applications
sources.quote: From the Details tab, enable Expose to agentic apps.

sources.title: 🐴 Create and Configure Workflows for Use in Agentic Applications
sources.quote: Pass user input and history explicitly.

sources.title: 🐴 Anatomy of an Agentic Application
sources.quote: Any subsequent questions, actions, and communications are then scoped to the selected agent.

sources.title: 🐴 Monitor and Evaluate AI Agents
sources.quote: Test your agents for response correctness, response time, and token usage to meet your quality standards.

sources.title: 🐴 Override Node Configuration
sources.quote: If the override fixes the issue, select Accept to apply it to the workflow.

sources.title: 🐴 Rerun, Step Through, or Resume a Workflow
sources.quote: Step: Run the next node and pause again.

sources.title: 🐴 Overview of Agentic Applications
sources.quote: Communications always initiate outbound messages; they never intercept or receive incoming messages.
